HTTPS Client

gxsHTTPClient sends HTTPS requests and follows redirects. Plain http:// is refused.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

Each request opens a new TLS connection, checks the server certificate, sends the request with Connection: close, and reads the whole response into a gxsHTTPMessage. Up to five redirects are followed (SetMaxRedirects()), only to https:// URLs; credentials are not sent to a different host after a redirect. User names and passwords in the URL, or set with SetBasicAuth(), are sent as basic authentication.

gxsHTTPClient client;
gxsHTTPMessage resp;
if(client.Get("https://datareel.com/", resp) == 0)
  std::cout << resp.status << " " << resp.body.size() << " bytes\n";
else
  std::cerr << client.Error() << "\n";
